propositions: Add a new plan-review overlay criterion T15 that requires proving risky runtime-only mechanisms via a fast out-of-loop experiment before committing them into a slow codified delivery loop.
T15 applies only when a change is delivered through an automated pipeline, the pass is slow or costly, and correctness is runtime-only (boot, auth, connect, readiness).

T15 checks that plans name the specific runtime risks, commit to fast experiments (local or manual probe against real target), prove mechanisms before codifying, and clean up throwaway artifacts without touching pre-existing resources.
Update T10 rubric to partition durable infrastructure from transient de-risk experiments by adding a scope clause excluding throwaway experiments from T10 evaluation.
Regenerate plan-review documentation and criteria guide to include T15 guidance and verify T10 scope clause appears in both rubric and guide.
